document.title: Keep source clicks on the group and quiet the brief
document.summary: `openTargetForSource` stays on the current group when that group cites or lists the source. Nav, sources, and look-for hops become hash links. The brief hangs Why, What, Look for, and Sources in one body size, and Overview look-for starts collapsed.

sources.label: PR #81
sources.title: Keep group source clicks on the current group
sources.gist: A source cited on document lookFor and on a group jumped to Overview because claims.find hit the document claim first.

sources.label: 83f549c Prefer the current group when opening a shared source
sources.gist: Prefer the current group's lookFor cite, then any group lookFor, then named membership.

sources.label: 3f2bc56 Open Overview lookFor and style review hops as links
sources.gist: Overview lookFor starts expanded with a disclosure chevron. Hops use hash links.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 13
sources.gist: Asked for one type scale, hanging Why/What/Look for, less data at once, no double list rules, and source-row truncation that works on long labels.

sources.label: 337dd8a Let the overview brief start quiet and keep source rows in bounds
sources.gist: Collapse the Overview look-for index until opened, use a single divide, and truncate long source labels.

lookFor: [PR #81](source:s1) and [3f2bc56](source:s3) say Overview lookFor starts expanded. [337dd8a](source:s5) opens that disclosure only when a document claim is focused.
[PR #81](source:s1) test plan says hop labels are underlined `<a href>` targets. `hashLinkText` underlines on hover; resting underline is gone on cards and nav.

groups.title: Prefer the current group for a shared source
groups.why: [PR #81](source:s1) reports that a source cited on document lookFor and on a group jumped to Overview. [83f549c](source:s2) names the find-first bug.
groups.summary: `openTargetForSource` prefers a line pin, then a lookFor owned by `currentGroupId`, then `groupSourceIds` on that group, then any group lookFor, named `group.sources`, document lookFor, Overview.
lookFor: From group `login`, a ticket cited in document lookFor and in `login` lookFor opens `#group/login` and focuses `group:login:0`, not Overview.
A source listed on `group.sources` with no lookFor cite still stays on that group when it is current.

groups.title: HashLink and plain-click guard
groups.why: Sidebar, sources, look-for hops, and story hops need one `<a href>` that still runs in-app select on an unmodified left click.
groups.summary: `HashLink` writes `serializeHash` and calls `onSelect` only when `isPlainLeftClick` is true. `hashLinkText` is hover underline for running text.
lookFor: Cmd-click or middle-click on a hop follows the hash in a new tab and does not call `onSelect`.

groups.title: Wire hops to HashLink
groups.why: [3f2bc56](source:s3) wants look-for rows, sources, sidebar titles, and story hops as real hash links so [PR #81](source:s1) source clicks share the same target.
groups.summary: Sidebar, Overview group rows, Look for index hops, SourceList jumps, and HopList use `HashLink`. Source rows call `selectionForSource`.
lookFor: A SourceList row for a URL source still opens the external URL on the label, and the gist hops in-app through `selectionForSource`.

groups.title: Hanging brief fields and one title size
groups.why: [Cursor session · Sep 13](source:s4) asked for an intentional type scale: display only on the title, Why and What as body, Look for easy to find, nothing larger than the header.
groups.summary: `BriefField` hangs kickers in a 5.75rem column. Why, What, Look for, and Sources share `briefProse`. Title uses `--text-title` / `--text-title-sm`. Overview group rows drop display numerals.
lookFor: Subtle. `--text-title` is 2.25rem, matching main after `Increase font size`. `text-title` and `text-foreground` both use the `text-` prefix; the title must still render at 2.25rem on desktop.

groups.title: Quiet Overview look-for and single divides
groups.why: [Cursor session · Sep 13](source:s4) said the hanging brief dumped too much at once, and double separator lines added noise. [337dd8a](source:s5) names the collapse.
groups.summary: Overview document look-for starts closed unless a document claim is focused. Lists use `briefRows` (`divide-y` only). Tagged claims hang the tag in a 4.75rem column.
lookFor: Subtle. Nested document claims use `divide-y` with no `border-y`, so the parent index does not stack a double rule under the last claim.

groups.title: Truncate long source labels
groups.why: [Cursor session · Sep 13](source:s4) showed a commit label overflowing the Sources row on a narrow pane. [337dd8a](source:s5) caps the label.
groups.summary: Source labels cap at 40% and truncate. The gist is `flex-1 truncate` inside an `overflow-hidden` row.
lookFor: For label `4243b14 Reject unknown values in the table extra config array` at ~390px, the label shows an ellipsis and the gist still truncates in the remaining width.

commits.subject: Let the overview brief start quiet and keep source rows in bounds
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Expanded document look-for plus boxed list rules dumped the whole review at once. Collapse the index until it is opened, use a single divide between rows, and truncate long source labels so they cannot overflow the hanging column.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commits.subject: Give the brief one type scale and a hanging scan column
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Display type was competing across title, why, and the group list. Keep it on the title, hang why/what/look-for as fields, and tighten the vertical rhythm so a reviewer can find Look for without scrolling past a second headline.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commits.subject: Tone down hop underlines and kickers
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Resting underlines on cards and nav were heavy. Keep hover underline in running text, wash look-for rows on hover, and drop tracked uppercase on kickers.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commits.subject: Paint hop underlines on the text node
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Flex HashLinks never showed hover:underline on their children. Underline the label text instead so Look for rows, sources, and sidebar titles read as links.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Open Overview lookFor and style review hops as links
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Overview lookFor starts expanded with a disclosure chevron. Sidebar,
lookFor rows, and sources use hash links with hover underline. Source
labels match lookFor claim size and weight.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Prefer the current group when opening a shared source
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Document lookFor claims come first in the list, so a citation that also
belongs to a group jumped to Overview. Prefer the current group's claim,
then any group lookFor, then named membership.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
